modeReason: Several top stories clear the threshold on their own: the AI stock sell-off (novelty 2 × magnitude 3 × breadth 3 = 18) and the AI-assisted Riemann hypothesis claim (3 × 3 × 2 = 18) both exceed 8, so today is a fresh day regardless of the industry balance rule.
phrase: AI stocks just had their worst week in years, erasing trillions in value. Meanwhile, a company's own researcher says its chatbot helped him solve a 167-year-old math problem.
phraseAlternatives: This week, AI companies lost trillions in stock value. This week, one of their own researchers says he might have solved a 167-year-old math problem.
A sell-off wiped trillions off AI stocks this week. The same company's researcher claims a chatbot helped him crack a problem mathematicians couldn't solve in 167 years.
Investors erased trillions from AI stocks in days. A researcher at the same company says an AI just helped him solve one of math's oldest open problems.
AI markets had their worst week in six years. One struggling company's researcher says its own chatbot just helped crack a 167-year-old math problem.

brief.concept: A company's building cracks open above a plunging stock chart while, inside the very same walls, one of its own researchers proudly circles a checked equation on a chalkboard with a small AI robot beside him.
brief.metaphor: Financial collapse and intellectual triumph happening under the same roof, on the same day.

cast.who: a company building cracking above a steep falling stock chart
a human researcher at a chalkboard, chalk in hand, circling a dense equation
a small AI robot beside the researcher, pointing at a checkmark on the chalkboard
a worried investor figure outside, holding a shrinking price tag, looking up at the lit window

brief.composition: Split scene within one cross-sectioned building, blueprint-style: lower half shows the building's foundation cracking over a sharp downward stock-chart line with a falling arrow; upper half shows the interior where the researcher and the small robot stand at a chalkboard dense with careful line-drawn equations, one term circled and checked. Outside on the pavement, the investor stands small and separate, clutching a shrinking price tag, looking up. One yellow highlight marks the checked equation as the point of the joke.
brief.alt: A technical blueprint-style drawing of a building cracking above a plunging stock chart, while inside, a researcher and a small robot proudly circle a checked equation on a chalkboard, as a worried investor outside watches a shrinking price tag.
